name: datafog
description: Keeps emails, phone numbers, card and ID numbers, API keys and other credentials out of the model's context: values in files, command output and tool results are replaced by reversible markers before Claude sees them, and swapped back locally when Claude writes. Development build; see the README for what is and is not covered.

keep_vault_on_uninstall.title: Keep the vault when the plugin is uninstalled
keep_vault_on_uninstall.description: On: the vault (the table that turns markers back into your real values) is stored in your user data folder and survives an uninstall. Off: it is stored in the plugin's data folder, which Claude Code deletes on uninstall; markers left in your files can then never be restored.

unscannable_file_policy.title: Files that cannot be checked
unscannable_file_policy.description: What to do when Claude reads a file DataFog cannot check (images, PDFs, binary or very large files): ask you each time, deny the read, or allow it unchecked.

entities.title: Entity types to detect
entities.description: Comma-separated list, or empty for the default set (EMAIL, PHONE, SSN, CREDIT_CARD, API_KEY, BEARER_TOKEN, JWT, PRIVATE_KEY, CREDENTIAL_URI, US_ROUTING_NUMBER, NPI, ACCOUNT_NUMBER). Also available, noisy in code: DATE, IP_ADDRESS, ZIP_CODE, STREET_ADDRESS, UUID.
